database_name: ArtVision Miami Art Week Exhibition Opportunities
notes: Running database for ArtVision podcast. Prefer free opportunities. Searchable by keyword (e.g., Miami, digital, Web3). Mark expired when past deadline. Encouraging voice.

opportunities.title: Render Network: Miami After Dark
opportunities.miami_art_week_context: During Miami Art Week / Art Basel Miami Beach period (approx Nov 30–Dec 6, 2026)
opportunities.fee: None (no participation fee). Rendering credits provided for selected works.
opportunities.looking_for: Original digital work themed 'Miami After Dark', up to 2 minutes, must be rendered on Render Network. 10-15 artists selected for 50-foot large-scale projection.
opportunities.includes_event_entry: Yes – selected works exhibited in the projection showcase.
opportunities.application_questions_approx: Short Typeform (~7 minutes); basic info + work submission.
opportunities.receipts_required: Rendered video/piece (up to 2 min) + supporting details.
opportunities.notes: Strong Web3/decentralized tech angle. Zero cost to artist.

opportunities.title: .ART Award 2026
opportunities.organization: .ART Registry / UKCI Holdings (with partners including HUG, BitBasel)
opportunities.type: Global award + recognition / potential exhibition visibility
opportunities.location: Announcement at Art Basel Miami Beach; gallery opt-in at BitBasel Miami
opportunities.event_dates: Winners announced December 3, 2026 at Art Basel Miami Beach
opportunities.miami_art_week_context: Tied directly to Art Basel Miami Beach and BitBasel during Miami Art Week
opportunities.fee: None. Requires a .ART domain (often free or low-cost to claim via HUG or partners).
opportunities.looking_for: Any medium. Documentation of process: bio (min 100 words), work visuals with technical details, story of creation (min 100 words or short video).
opportunities.includes_event_entry: Recognition during the week; opt-in gallery screens at BitBasel; major prizes including cash, residencies, editorial.
opportunities.eligibility: Artists and collectives 18+, worldwide, all art forms.
opportunities.application_questions_approx: Minimal form – submit .ART URL. Content requirements on the linked page/site.
opportunities.receipts_required: 1. Bio (100+ words), 2. Work documentation (images/video/3D + captions), 3. Process story (text or video). All via the .ART-linked site/profile.
opportunities.notes: Extremely prestigious free opportunity. Jury includes Jerry Saltz. Over $50k in prizes. Exhibition visibility component.

opportunities.title: Art Miami Magazine Open Call for Artist Interviews
opportunities.type: Editorial feature / interview (potential print during Art Week)
opportunities.location: Online + social + considered for special print editions distributed during Miami Art Week
opportunities.event_dates: Ongoing; features timed around key Miami art events including Art Week 2026
opportunities.miami_art_week_context: Explicitly considers selected artists for special editions and print features during key art events in Miami
opportunities.looking_for: Visual artists of any medium whose work contributes to contemporary scene. Miami connection a plus but not required.
opportunities.includes_event_entry: Editorial exposure; potential inclusion in print distributed during Art Week.
opportunities.eligibility: Emerging to established, any country, all mediums.
opportunities.receipts_required: 6 high-res photos (with title/medium/size/year), art statement (200-400 words), short bio (3-5 lines), contact/website/Instagram.
opportunities.notes: Free ongoing opportunity for visibility during the peak season.

opportunities.title: arteNXT Digital Exhibition – Official 2026
opportunities.location: Digital on ARTWEEK platform; potential physical promo ties in Wynwood
opportunities.event_dates: Miami Art Week Nov 30–Dec 6, 2026; digital presence through Oct 31, 2027
opportunities.fee: Application fee (non-refundable) + participation fee if accepted (~$279 Miami digital or $399 multi-city)
opportunities.fee_reason: Official exhibitor designation, curated digital presence, membership, potential display/promo during the week, year-round ecosystem access. Prestigious within the Miami Art Week official programs.
opportunities.looking_for: Contemporary visual art including digital, AI-assisted, new media. Emerging to established, worldwide. Gallery rep not required.
opportunities.includes_event_entry: Official designation and promotional opportunities during Miami Art Week.
opportunities.receipts_required: Up to 6 images of work, bio, etc.
opportunities.notes: Included because of official prestige and clear benefits despite fees. Prefer free options first.
